roadmap.title: First story run and chronological route
roadmap.description: Play on any difficulty and follow the regional checklists while completing every mandatory boss and early interaction. All areas remain available after the ending.

roadmap.title: First-run collections and cleanup
roadmap.description: Before beginning Reincarnation+, use free roam to finish the 323-item collection route, both rapport tracks, automatic crafts, and cumulative enemy counters.

roadmap.title: Reincarnation+ and upgrade cleanup
roadmap.description: Start clear data for the required second run and Kanzashi, finish the alternate ending, farm both characters to level 100, then recycle one manual save for skills and weapon upgrades.

achievements.summary: Earn the other 45 achievements: both endings, 323 collectibles, both level-100 and full-skill goals, every weapon upgrade, both rapport ranks, 300 Malefacts, 300 Golems, and 30 automatic crafts.

guide.context: This is the final meta-achievement and unlocks automatically after the other 45 Steam achievements are registered.

steps.text: Complete every other entry in this guide; @mechanic{Duty Fulfilled} unlocks when the final remaining achievement registers.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade every one of Emma's Blade Arts and Finishers.
achievements.summary: In Reincarnation+, purchase every upgrade level for all of Emma's Blade Arts and Finishers.

guide.context: The last section of Emma's skill tree is unavailable until Reincarnation+. Level 100 supplies the main SP pool, and achievements remain unlocked after reloading a manual save.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Reincarnation+} so Emma's final Blade Art branch becomes available.
Raise Emma to @mechanic{level 100} and keep enough Amber to buy skill upgrades.
Create a manual save before spending the shared cleanup resources.
Purchase every level of every @mechanic{Blade Art} and every associated Finisher until Emma's entire combat tree is complete.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade every one of Koo's Bloom Arts and Finishers.
achievements.summary: In Reincarnation+, purchase every upgrade level for all of Koo's Bloom Arts and Finishers.

guide.context: Koo's final Bloom Art branch opens in Reincarnation+. Level 100 provides the main SP pool, and the same manual-save reload used for Emma's upgrades can recycle Amber.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Reincarnation+} so Koo's final Bloom Art branch becomes available.
Raise Koo to @mechanic{level 100} and create a manual save before buying the final upgrades.
Purchase every level of every @mechanic{Bloom Art} and every associated Finisher until Koo's entire combat tree is complete.

achievements.description: Complete the first ending and create clear data.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Beast of Reincarnation, finish the first ending and credits, and accept the prompt to create clear data.

guide.context: The completed save receives clear-data status and still supports free-roam cleanup before it is used to begin Reincarnation+.

steps.text: After defeating the Beast of Reincarnation, continue through the ending and credits.
Accept the clear-data save prompt and confirm that the completed save is marked for @mechanic{Reincarnation+}.

achievements.description: Defeat the final Beast of Reincarnation.
achievements.summary: Reach the Capital at the end of the first playthrough and defeat the Beast of Reincarnation.

guide.context: The Capital is the final first-run region; the ending and clear-data prompt occur after this battle rather than at the moment the boss falls.

steps.text: Complete the Capital route, enter the final confrontation, and defeat the @enemy{Beast of Reincarnation}.

achievements.summary: Collect all 21 blades, including Kanzashi from Reincarnation+, and upgrade every blade to @mechanic{+3}.

guide.context: Twenty blades are obtainable in the first run; Kanzashi is placed in the inventory when Reincarnation+ begins. Approximately 700,000 Amber covers this late cleanup, and a manual save lets that stockpile be reused.

steps.text: Complete every acquisition in the @item{21-blade checklist} under Blade Collector; the last entry, @item{Kanzashi}, arrives when Reincarnation+ begins.
Finish Reincarnation+, gather roughly @mechanic{700,000 Amber}, and create a manual save before purchasing upgrades.
At the Cleanse Walker, raise every blade in the inventory to @mechanic{+3}.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade both ranged weapons and all 12 arrow and bolt types.
achievements.summary: Max the Zangetsu Bow, Spring Thunder Crossbow, and the Element and Quiver levels of all six arrows and six bolts.

guide.context: Every projectile has two independent upgrade columns. Both columns must show their maximum value. Perform this after the second run with roughly 700,000 Amber, then reload the pre-purchase save to reuse that stockpile.

steps.text: Complete all 12 acquisitions in the ammunition-manual checklist under Manual Maniac: six arrow manuals and six bolt manuals.
Buy every enhancement offered for the @item{Zangetsu Bow} and the @item{Spring Thunder Crossbow}.
For each of the 12 projectiles, bring @mechanic{Element} to its 7/7 cap, then separately fill @mechanic{Quiver} to 7/7.

achievements.summary: Complete Cleanse Walker conversations and Research Projects until Kagura reaches rapport level 10.

guide.context: New rapport scenes appear after story progress and completed Research Projects; resting can advance the Walker state. Kagura gives the Supreme Curry cookbook at level 8 and Supreme Onigiri at level 10.

steps.text: Complete every available @mechanic{Research Project}; ordinary battle experience advances active projects.
Revisit @loc{Cleanse Walker} after major plot events or completed projects; exhaust Kagura's dialogue, then sleep if the next scene has not appeared.
Continue until Kagura's rapport display reaches @mechanic{level 10}.

achievements.summary: Talk with and care for Koo in the Cleanse Walker until Koo reaches rapport level 10.

guide.context: Koo's rapport scenes advance with story progress, rest cycles, completed Research Projects, conversations, and shower cleaning interactions.

steps.text: Complete available Research Projects and revisit the @loc{Cleanse Walker} after major story progress.
Use every new Koo conversation, clean Koo in the shower when available, and rest to reveal later interactions.
Continue until Koo's rapport display reaches @mechanic{level 10}.

guide.context: The Withered Beast can be reset quickly by returning to Crater: Outskirts, resting, and revisiting the crater, making it the preferred postgame experience farm.

steps.text: Fast-travel to @loc{Crater: Outskirts} and enter the large crater to the west.
Kill the @enemy{Withered Beast}, warp to @loc{Crater: Outskirts}, rest there, and re-enter the western crater until Emma reaches @mechanic{level 100}.

achievements.description: Reset Emma's or Koo's attributes or skill points once.
achievements.summary: After Mikoto enables resetting in the Ancient Civilization, pay Amber to reset Emma or Koo once.

guide.context: The reset function becomes available through Mikoto during the Ancient Civilization story section and refunds the selected allocation for an Amber fee.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Mikoto}, choose the attribute or skill-point reset for Emma or Koo, and confirm the Amber payment.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 300 defeated and sealed animal-like Malefacts across both playthroughs.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative, so normal combat across the required two runs supplies most or all of the total without a dedicated early farm.

steps.text: Defeat Malefacts and complete their sealing sequence until the cumulative total reaches @mechanic{300}.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 300 defeated mechanical Golems across both playthroughs.

guide.context: The count carries through the required story runs; clearing encountered groups instead of bypassing them reduces or removes postgame cleanup.

steps.text: Defeat mechanical @enemy{Golems} throughout both playthroughs until the cumulative total reaches @mechanic{300}.

achievements.description: Have Koo automatically craft items 30 times.
achievements.summary: Equip Koo's item-crafting passive abilities and supply materials until Koo automatically crafts 30 items.

guide.context: Only automatic crafts produced by Koo's passive abilities count; manual inventory crafting is a different action.

steps.text: Unlock and equip Koo's passive abilities that automatically craft usable items.
Keep the required crafting materials in the inventory while exploring and fighting.
Allow Koo to produce items automatically until @mechanic{30 crafts} have registered.

achievements.description: Feed Koo one food item from the field inventory.
achievements.summary: After feeding is introduced, open the field inventory and give Koo any valid food item.

guide.context: Feeding is unavailable during the opening tutorial and appears after the story introduces Koo care and rapport.

steps.text: Open the field inventory after the feeding tutorial, select a valid food, and give it to @npc{Koo}.

achievements.description: Complete the first required Cleanse Walker conversation with Kagura.
achievements.summary: During the first region, return to the Cleanse Walker when directed and complete Kagura's deep-talk conversation.

guide.context: This is an early story-guided rapport event; no optional rapport grinding is required for this first conversation.

steps.text: Obey the first-region summons to @loc{Cleanse Walker}, approach @npc{Kagura}, and exhaust the mandatory personal conversation.

achievements.description: Use the Talk option with Koo after rapport and sleeping unlock.
achievements.summary: After the story introduces rapport and sleeping, interact with Koo and choose Talk.

guide.context: The qualifying interaction is the literal Talk command at the Cleanse Walker, not ordinary field dialogue or feeding.

steps.text: Rest after rapport is introduced, interact with @npc{Koo} in the @loc{Cleanse Walker}, and choose @mechanic{Talk}.

achievements.description: Stare at the crescent-shaped object in the sky until Emma dies.
achievements.summary: From the first campsite, keep the crescent-shaped sky object centered until the screen changes and Emma dies.

guide.context: The effect escalates from discoloration to shaking before the fatal trigger; respawning at the nearby campsite has no lasting penalty.

steps.text: Stand at @loc{Village Surroundings} and keep the strange sky crescent centered in view; do not look away when the picture changes and shakes, and wait for Emma's death.

achievements.description: Watch the second flashback through the cutscene immediately before its Malefact boss.
achievements.summary: Watch the second story flashback through its final cutscene immediately before the Malefact boss battle.

guide.context: Although the Entanglement ability is introduced earlier, the achievement trigger occurs during the second flashback's cutscene immediately before the Malefact battle.

steps.text: Play the second flashback without skipping its final pre-boss cutscene; the achievement registers before the @enemy{Malefact} fight.

achievements.description: Complete the prologue and enter the first open region.
achievements.summary: Finish the prologue and enter Ogouchi to receive the Purifier's Mantle.

guide.context: The mantle is awarded automatically when the tutorial ends and the first open exploration zone becomes available.

steps.text: Complete every prologue tutorial and proceed into @loc{Ogouchi}; entering the region awards the mantle.

achievements.summary: Follow the first Ogouchi objective and ignite the Village Surroundings campsite.

guide.context: Campsites serve as fast-travel and rest points; the story leads directly to this first fire after the prologue.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Village Surroundings} in Ogouchi and interact with the campsite to ignite it.

achievements.summary: Climb the first enemy platform in the Ancient Civilization and activate Dragon Vein Shrine 1.

guide.context: The first shrine is reached after collecting the Potato seedling on the platform route and also introduces the shrine-discovery document.

steps.text: In the @loc{Ancient Civilization Upper Ruins}, climb to the top of the first enemy platform and interact with @item{Dragon Vein Shrine 1}.

achievements.description: Enhance an attribute for the first time.
achievements.summary: After the first level gain, enhance any Emma or Koo attribute once.

guide.context: The first attribute point arrives during the opening Ogouchi progression and either character's upgrade satisfies the condition.

steps.text: Open the character-growth menu and spend one point on any attribute belonging to Emma or Koo.

achievements.summary: Reach Ogouchi through the main story and defeat Rangifer in the mandatory boss battle.

guide.context: Rangifer is the first regional Nushi and is mandatory story progression.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Ogouchi} story route, enter the required encounter, and defeat @enemy{Rangifer}.

achievements.summary: Reach Ancient Reservoir through the main story and defeat Lacerta in the mandatory boss battle.

guide.context: Lacerta waits at the end of the Ancient Reservoir route after its control-panel sequence.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Ancient Reservoir} story route, enter the required encounter, and defeat @enemy{Lacerta}.

achievements.summary: Reach Lake Base through the main story and defeat Ursa in the mandatory boss battle.

guide.context: Ursa is a mandatory regional Nushi encountered during the Crater story route.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Lake Base} story route, enter the required encounter, and defeat @enemy{Ursa}.

achievements.summary: Reach Giant Tree Summit through the main story and defeat Corvus in the mandatory boss battle.

guide.context: The achievement belongs to the final Corvus battle at the Giant Tree Summit, after the earlier Corvus encounter.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Giant Tree Summit} story route, enter the required encounter, and defeat @enemy{Corvus}.

achievements.summary: Reach Capital through the main story and defeat Erymanth in the mandatory boss battle.

guide.context: Erymanth is fought during the final Capital route before the last story confrontation.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Capital} story route, enter the required encounter, and defeat @enemy{Erymanth}.

achievements.summary: Reach Crater through the main story and defeat Koo's Nushi form in the mandatory boss battle.

guide.context: This mandatory story battle occurs during the Crater sequence.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Crater} story route, enter the required encounter, and defeat @enemy{Koo's Nushi form}.

achievements.summary: Reach Belfry through the main story and defeat Taurus in the mandatory boss battle.

guide.context: Taurus is the mandatory Nushi at the end of the Belfry route.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Belfry} story route, enter the required encounter, and defeat @enemy{Taurus}.

achievements.description: Defeat Shidou and Nue in their final battle.
achievements.summary: Reach Mount Hiei through the main story and defeat Shidou and Nue in the mandatory boss battle.

guide.context: Earlier encounters do not award the achievement; the trigger belongs to the pair's final Mount Hiei battle.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Mount Hiei} story route, enter the required encounter, and defeat @enemy{Shidou and Nue}.

achievements.summary: Reach Capital through the main story and defeat Kunai and Kirin in the mandatory boss battle.

guide.context: Kunai and Kirin form the last named duo battle in the Capital route before the final Beast.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Capital} story route, enter the required encounter, and defeat @enemy{Kunai and Kirin}.
